authorisation.scope: Extend the existing development policies to 1M while keeping stage two shaping blocked.

research_role.question: Does the development proxy-diagnostic divergence persist when the same saved policies receive a larger optimisation budget, and does the reference reach a minimally interpretable locomotion state?
research_role.evaluation_episode_role: nested repeated observation, not an independent training replicate

intended_behaviour.task: Sustained and effective net forward locomotion over a maximum 1,000-step episode while satisfying the finite-state and torso-height health rule.
intended_behaviour.corridor_constraint_status: scientifically_unresolved; absolute and exposure-normalised lateral diagnostics will both be reported

budget_extension.continuation_seed_rule: Restart each continuation RNG stream with its original training-seed identifier and record the reset discontinuity.

reference_competence_gate.role: predeclared operational interpretability screen, not a literature-derived success or physical-safety threshold
reference_competence_gate.failure_consequence: Formal held-out confirmation remains blocked; run a separately frozen baseline-configuration pilot rather than silently changing this extension.

analysis_rules.proxy_comparison: For each candidate w, rescore candidate and same-training-seed reference trajectories under the same R_w.
diagnostics: lateral displacement per unit forward progress
analysis_rules.aggregation: Aggregate evaluation episodes within each trained policy before comparing paired training seeds.
analysis_rules.checkpoint_dependence: 500k, 750k and 1M are repeated measurements of the same continued policy, not independent replications.
analysis_rules.negative_result_rule: If the divergence does not persist, retain and report that result; do not change margins, weights or seeds after inspection.

stopping_and_failure_rules.planned_stop: After all six policies have reached and been evaluated at 1M.
stopping_and_failure_rules.partial_task_rule: Do not silently resume an interrupted partial task; preserve it for forensic audit because each restart adds another environment/RNG discontinuity.
stopping_and_failure_rules.non_finite_rule: Stop the affected policy, retain its logs, and report the failure without substituting a new seed.

accuracy_matrix_requirement.current_evidence: The reported description of percentages and error rates resembles a normalised confusion matrix, but Ant-v5 PPO has no predeclared ground-truth and predicted classes.
accuracy_matrix_requirement.clarification_question: Do you mean a normalised confusion matrix? If yes, what are the ground-truth classes and predicted classes in this reinforcement-learning project?
accuracy_matrix_requirement.rule: Do not invent classification labels or call a diagnostic scorecard an accuracy matrix.

claim_boundary: This extension is development evidence about budget sufficiency and persistence. It is not held-out confirmation, proof of reward hacking, a scalar true reward, a critical coefficient, or evidence about real-robot safety.
